text_block_list.name: Bourbon & Rice
text_block_list.text: *Sneak sneak...*

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Approach successful without alerting
Target ①.
Proceeding to the next 'Friendship
Mission.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'Friendship Mission'...
What comes to mind is
that plan those two were looking into in
the library before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, I request your cooperation
with the 'Friendship Mission.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—! Understood... Rice will help!
With the 'Friendship Mission'!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
'The Bestest Friends☆Club', Volume 7,
Chapter 1.
Recording the actions of a pair of close
friends—initiating execution.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hachi-mi~, hachi-mi~♪
McQueen,
thanks for the treat again today~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whatever are you talking about?
Today,
I shall end my rock-paper-scissors losing
streak
and graciously allow you to treat me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh~!
I'm not giving up my undefeated record~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Sparks are flying, but they're
both smiling... They must be good friends!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
'Playing rock-paper-scissors for a honey
drink.'
'Sparks fly,
then smiles'... Recording complete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that,
I often ran into the two of them
carrying out their plan wherever I went—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaand that's why☆ we totally gotta hit up
a cute cafe,
snap some killer pics, and get hyped,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totally down for that, big time~!
Let's make a mad dash away from these downer
vibes!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Bae... sage... Language recognition failed.
Cannot record. 
Determining that language comprehension must
be executed first.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey,
did you decide which sports towel to buy?
I already picked mine~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah! All right then... ready, set...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Satono
text_block_list.text: Wait!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Satono
text_block_list.text: ...It's the same!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Matching towels might be nice.
It feels like we're working hard together—
gets me fired up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah! How nice, you're matching.
And speaking at the exact same time too,
you two really seem like the best of
friends!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see...
'Purchase matching items to build morale.'
'Speak in unison'... Recording complete.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――All surveys complete.
Initiating simulation based on survey
results.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Executing scan...
Rise in body temperature and heart rate
confirmed.
Status determined: 'High Spirits'.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Rice is looking forward to it too.
And no misfortune happened today—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Wham!*)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Electronic devices, completely silent.
In other words, it's broken.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! It's all because Rice said
nothing bad happened...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on historical data,
the malfunction of electronic devices
is estimated with 99% probability to be due
to my physical contact.
In other words... it is not your fault,
Rice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rerouting reference source for investigation
data to internal memory.
Execution capability will decrease by 20%,
but it is inevitable.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... Bourbon-san! Th-this!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Checking Rice-san's notebook for today's
survey logs.
...It has been recorded in meticulous
detail.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yep!
I wrote it down just in case.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Execution capability,
previously reduced by 20%, has
recovered to 100% thanks to Rice-san's
notebook. ...Rice-san,
you have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No! If Rice... was able to help,
then Rice is really happy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Keeping up this momentum,
our next mission... Volume 9,
Chapter 8 of 'Besties ☆ Best Friends
Club.'
Let us carry out the 'Best Friends Date.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
My heart's pounding a little,
but I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
the two of them set out to complete the
'Friendship Mission'
while growing ever closer.
